body.name: Refitted arm-vector \(m\)-out-of-\(n\) procedure and raw scalar diagnostic
body.construction:
Choose \(m\to\infty\) with \(m/n\to0\).  Conditionally on \(O_1,\ldots,O_n\), draw \(B\) uniformly from the subsets of \(\{1,\ldots,n\}\) of size \(m\).  For each realized \(B\), refit the joint learner, generalized-inverse scales, clips, preliminary quantiles, endpoint corrections, and densities using only observations indexed by \(B\).  Define
\[
 V_{B,a}(\tau)=\frac m{\widehat H_{a,m,B}}
 \{\widehat q_{a,B}^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)-\widehat q_a^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)\},
 \qquad
 T_{B,n}(\tau)=\widehat\ell_{1,n}V_{B,1}(\tau)-\widehat\ell_{0,n}V_{B,0}(\tau).
\]
The conditional coordinate quantiles \(c_{n,p}(\tau)\), maximum \(M_{B,n}\), maximum quantile \(c^{\max}_{n,p}\), and band \(\mathcal C_n^{\mathrm{sim}}\) are then exactly as displayed in the frozen construction.  For comparison only, define the raw scalar refit by
\[
 T^{\mathrm{raw}}_{B,n}(\tau)
 =\frac m{\max_{a\in\mathcal A}\widehat H_{a,m,B}}
 \left[
 \{\widehat q_{1,B}^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)-\widehat q_{0,B}^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)\}
 -\{\widehat q_1^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)-\widehat q_0^{\mathrm{bc}}(\tau)\}
 \right].
\]
This raw statistic is an internal diagnostic and is not attributed to a published procedure.
inputs: a conditional uniform randomizer over size-\(m\) subsets, or exact enumeration
